description: Completes alignment, as the Complete Alignment button of the app does. Call it only when get_alignment gives ready_to_complete true, and the customer says to complete alignment. When get_alignment gives complete_statement, show this exact statement first, and get an explicit yes: "Once you complete alignment, any further changes to your prenup will need to be done by a lawyer. Are you sure you want to continue?" Then call with confirm true. When both partners completed alignment, the app makes the draft prenup. The completion emails the customer and the partner. Give the customer next_step or waiting_for_partner. When the result gives upgrade, offer the upgrade to Lawyer Review with its text and url.

confirm.description: True only after the customer said yes to complete alignment, and to complete_statement when get_alignment gives it.

name: complete_alignment

completed_now.description: False when alignment was already complete. The tool then changed nothing.

next_step.description: The current module of the customer.

upgrade.description: Only for a prenup that can upgrade to Lawyer Review: the offer of the app.

waiting_for_partner.description: Why the next module waits for the partner.

title: Complete alignment
